fod-strip.text: Horizontal three-panel newspaper strip, clean and readable. Consistent cream masthead/header row: left side reads exactly 'The Forces of Darkness, LLC.' in prominent left-aligned type; right side reads exactly 'by Star Splitter Visions' in smaller right-aligned type. Individual strip title is subordinate, positioned under the main title at left. Keep both edges legible with generous padding, never centered or placed over the story panels. Bold inked outlines, clean repeatable silhouettes, muted plum/brick/olive/gold palette, simple flat shading, readable deadpan acting, spacious unobstructed speech balloons. Preserve body-size hierarchy (Hork far larger than Eric), established outfits, and exact supplied dialogue and speaker ownership. The evil occupation, dungeon, curses, raids or army infrastructure remains visibly real. Keep a balanced comic rhythm; let the final panel deliver the authored reversal. Each strip stands alone, without invented story continuity.
